summary: A dark developer landing page built on a stock Bootstrap/Unify template: Revolution Slider hero on rows of huge binary digits, feature lists, code screenshots in signal-colour frames, and copy-paste CDN snippets. Almost all type on the page is the template's sans (Helvetica Neue, Open Sans); Hack appears mainly in images, the only live Hack being the CDN snippets.

instances.look: Three rows of huge '1010101' in Hack, ghosted at the top and bright at the bottom, on near-black dotted texture, under a centred boxed tagline, three short lines and three outlined buttons
instances.ux: Full-viewport slider: on load the digit background splits into curtain strips, then captions drop in one after another; a second slide ('By Devs, For Devs', in the DOM only) follows. Buttons LEARN MORE, TRY IT, DOWNLOAD
instances.learn: Binary digits are the perfect sample for a code font: the slashed-dotted zero against the 1 shows the font's key disambiguation at billboard size, and it needs no copy

reconstruction.layout: Full-bleed 1440×900; background image of 3 digit rows ~290px tall cropped at the edges; tagline box centred at y≈300 (846px wide, 1px rules top and bottom, stars at both ends); lines at y≈415–510; button row y≈575
reconstruction.typography: Digits ~400px Hack Regular (image), opacity ~10% / ~18% / ~75% from top to bottom; tagline 32px Helvetica Neue uppercase white; lines 26px; buttons 13px uppercase, 1px white border. The headline is not set in Hack
reconstruction.behaviour: Revolution Slider: data-transition curtain-1, 5 slots, 700ms; captions .tp-caption sft (slide from top) at data-start 2000ms and 3000ms, Back.easeInOut; 2-slide autoplay with slideup transition to bg-hack2.png
reconstruction.content: 'A TYPEFACE DESIGNED FOR SOURCE CODE', 'Designed for the screen. Open source. Libre.'
reconstruction.assets: Background PNG of binary digits; dotted overlay .tp-dottedoverlay.twoxtwo

instances.look: FEATURES: three dark cards with a green icon disc, title, one line and a ruled list of 5–8 properties (Metrics & Style, Type Traits, Free and Open Source). A three-column row of icon points ('A Family of Four Faces', 'Multilingual', 'Powerline Support') sits at y≈900–1146 between hero and block 01; it was never cut as a block and is attached here
instances.ux: Static; a link to the licence in the third card
instances.learn: Listing traits as a spec (large x-height, open counters, oval-filled zero) speaks developers' language: properties, not adjectives

reconstruction.layout: Centred heading with a short green rule beneath; 3 equal columns ~370px wide inside a 1170px container, 30px gaps, cards a shade lighter than the page; icon disc 74px; list rows ~50px with thin green dividers ~270px wide
reconstruction.typography: Section title 28px Open Sans Light uppercase; card title 22px Open Sans Light; description 15px Merriweather; list items 16px Lato Light, centred, grey
reconstruction.content: Real trait lists: minimal stroke contrast, large x-height, open counters, wide apertures, sturdy terminals; free to modify, free for print, desktop & web, free for commercial use

instances.look: 'A WORKHORSE FOR CODE' heading, 'No frills. No gimmicks.', then one large screenshot of a dark code editor showing syntax-highlighted Angular source set in Hack
instances.learn: For a code font the single most convincing proof is the real environment: a full editor window at true size, with line numbers and syntax colours

reconstruction.layout: Section ~1024px tall, centred heading, 2 lines, then screenshot 1000×620px centred with a thin light title bar
reconstruction.typography: Heading 28px Open Sans Light uppercase with short green rule; lines 18px grey sans; code ~13px Hack in the image
reconstruction.content: A real function (Angular's forEach) with comments

instances.look: A parallax band with two count-up figures, '1573 GLYPHS' and '129 CONTRIBUTORS'. It sits at y≈2170–2377 between blocks 01 and 02, was never cut as a block, and shows only in the video and mobile strip
instances.ux: Counters run up from low values when scrolled into view (t=4.5s shows 15 and 1); background parallaxes
instances.learn: A contributor count beside the glyph count makes community a feature of the typeface

reconstruction.layout: Full-bleed ~207px band; four col-sm-3 slots with the outer two empty, so the two figures sit centre; number over label
reconstruction.typography: Numbers ~36px white sans; labels 12px uppercase grey
reconstruction.behaviour: jQuery counterUp on span.counter when in view (~1.5s); .parallaxBg background shifts with scroll

instances.look: Dark textured band: 'A TYPEFACE IN THE BITSTREAM VERA LINEAGE' and two centred sentences
instances.learn: Crediting the open-source ancestry (Bitstream Vera, DejaVu) in two lines is the libre-community version of a history chapter

reconstruction.layout: Full-bleed 307px, centred column ~1040px, heading, short green rule, two sentences
reconstruction.typography: Heading 28px Open Sans Light uppercase; body 16px sans grey, leading ~1.6
reconstruction.content: 'Hack has deep roots in the libre, open source typeface community and includes the contributions of the Bitstream Vera & DejaVu projects.'

instances.look: 'THE CAST OF CHARACTERS': a white card with a thick yellow frame, giant 'Aa' over three lines of ASCII (uppercase + 01234, lowercase + 56789, symbols)
instances.feel: Loud against the dark page, classic specimen
instances.ux: The whole image links to the full specimen page ('Click either image above for a full type specimen')
instances.learn: One card can stand in for the glyph table: all ASCII, including the symbols coders care about, plus a click-through for the rest

reconstruction.layout: Heading + 2 lines, then 750×550px image centred, ~15px solid yellow border, white ground; 'Aa' fills the top 65%, three text lines justified below

instances.look: A second card with a thick red frame: 'Händgrovels 12345' four times, in Regular, Italic, Bold and Bold Italic
instances.learn: A word with an umlaut and digits is the shortest useful style test for a code font

reconstruction.layout: 750×550px image, ~15px solid red border, ~#ebebeb ground; two pairs of lines with a gap between roman and bold
reconstruction.typography: ~58px Hack in the four styles, left aligned as a block, centred on the card

instances.look: Three edge-to-edge tiles of code in display sizes: red with 'printf' (C), slate with ''use strict';' (JS), yellow with '#!/usr/bin/env' (Python), each cropped. The 'SOURCE EXAMPLES' heading above them was not cut as a block
instances.feel: Bold, poster-like, the liveliest part of the page
instances.ux: Static images in a borderless three-column list
instances.learn: Code keywords are display type: set 'printf' huge and a font specimen becomes a language poster that every programmer reads instantly

reconstruction.layout: Full-bleed 3 equal columns (480×320), no gutters, content cropped at the right edge; each tile: one giant keyword line plus 2–5 lines of code, sometimes a white or black strip at the bottom
reconstruction.typography: Keyword ~120–60px Hack Bold or Bold Italic; code ~36px Hack Regular with bold keywords and italic types; heading 28px Open Sans Light
reconstruction.content: Short real code per language: C (printf, int func(const char *var), JavaScript ('use strict', REGEXP), Python (shebang, try/except ImportError)

instances.look: 'DISTINCT GLYPH SHAPES': two green-disc points at left (A Handful of Serifs, Weight and Spacing) beside a yellow-framed code sample designed to stress lookalike characters
instances.learn: A torture-test code snippet ('O0,l1,Z2,S5,G6,B8') shows disambiguation and heavier punctuation together in the real context

reconstruction.layout: Container 1170px; left 50% has 2 rows (68px disc + title + 4–5 lines of text); right 50% has a 540×320 image in a ~15px yellow frame with black bands above and below the light code area

reconstruction.content: Code pangram: '// The five boxing wizards jump', 'unsigned O0,l1,Z2,S5,G6,B8__XY;', 'int 0xFaced=0xBAD||"[{(CQUINE";'

instances.look: Over a dark blurred parallax image, a drag carousel of five white tiles at a time, each with one confusable pair: l1, Z2, S5, G6, B8 (nine tiles including O0, from the image set); one caption line below in block 08
instances.ux: Grab and drag the tiles left or right to reach other pairs (owl-carousel); the caption tells you to drag
instances.learn: Confusable pairs as flash cards: the only test that matters for a code font, one tile per pair, with no explanation needed

instances.look: Three stacked centred sections: DOWNLOAD with two green OS buttons, TRY HACK IN YOUR BROWSER with a link to the external font playground, WEB FONT CDN with two boxed <link> snippets set in Hack
